raw_response:
I am only 10 years old, so I help my father on our small millet plot. I do what he tells me — we plant our own seed we kept from last harvest, and we do not buy the expensive fertilizer from town because money is small. My father sometimes puts the goat droppings on the field before the rains come, and we weed many times with the hoe. We do not have a pump, so we wait for the rains like everyone in our village.
